cites.quote: API tests use Vitest and Supertest against a throwaway PostgreSQL 16 with a fixed clock.
Every PRD requirement has at least one test whose name starts with its ID
Without either, database tests are skipped.
The verifier skips coverage (the project has no coverage script)
HMS-3 REQ-2/REQ-4: counts a No-show that starts in the selected period
must not contain the fixture patient's phone (`+91`), email, allergies (`Penicillin`)
fullName: 'Test Patient One', dateOfBirth: '1990-05-01', gender: 'FEMALE', phone: '+91 00000 20001',
has a blood group, allergies, chronic conditions, current medications, notes and every contact detail the patient record holds

findings.suggested_fix: Seed a patient in the test with email and every medical-history field and assert none appear. Otherwise drop the email wording and list the unseeded S-6 fields under Not covered.
findings.text: The artifact says the test checks that the fixture patient's email is absent, but patient 1 has no email seeded. S-6 also needs blood group, conditions and medications seeded. These seeding gaps are not listed under Not covered.

rubric_items.reason: Tests cover the count, the started filter, the 400 path, the tile, its link and URL forwarding. The weeks-later test now covers S-1 AC4, S-3 AC2 and S-4 AC2. The two gaps left (S-1 AC3, S-5 AC3) are listed with reasons.
Assertions check exact counts, list ids against the count, 400 field-error bodies, the whole totals object with toEqual, and every tile's text and href in order.

Covers the strict boundary at now (10:14, 10:15, +1 ms), zero, the next day, weeks later, closed statuses and three bad started values. The local-midnight case is not tested, and S-6 fields are only partly seeded.
API tests use Vitest, Supertest and their own throwaway DB, skipped without PostgreSQL. Web tests use jsdom and sit where the layout puts them. Names start with HMS-21 REQ-n, like the HMS-3 tests.
No counts or coverage are invented. tests and coverage are left to the verifier, and checks.json shows coverage skipped with exit 78.
